question: In a certain code language, 'BOOK' is written as 'ZNNI' and 'SHOP' is written as 'QFNN'. How will 'NOTES' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'BOOK' is written as 'ZNNI'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a92987d9c986ee5a609e42a1ab658dd6d91387782d5c4cb2cce79482504de09c.png] 

And,

'SHOP' is written as 'QFNN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/07136c85770f4584310a067098592a43a7bc7eca3f6c90de57fef167b6d8d89d.png] 

Similarly,

'NOTES' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0fa31774a0365b72a27683972dd7064ca39a093896d1454109f0dd239a9227e.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
